name: B10-0376/2025 (PfE) – Detention of EU citizens in the occupied areas of Cyprus
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the detention of EU citizens in the occupied areas of Cyprus
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the release of five elderly Greek Cypriot citizens arrested in July 2025 in the occupied north of Cyprus while visiting their old family properties. It says the charges against them are politically motivated and unfounded. It asks the European Union and its member states to put diplomatic pressure on Turkey, which it holds responsible for the occupation, and to monitor human rights in the occupied areas. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing in law. Parliament states a position and makes demands.
- **Who it affects:** The five detained citizens, Cyprus, Turkey, and European Union institutions.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the relevant parties; no binding action follows from it.
